messages.en: You're a real lifesaver, helping me out when my car broke down earlier!
Aw, I only helped a little. Good thing I was there.

senses.en_definition: An informal exclamation used to greet someone, attract attention, or express surprise or annoyance.

messages.en: Hey, are you here yet? I'm waiting out front of the shop.
Yes, but it turns out I'm at the back entrance. Hang on, I'll walk round to the front.
Hi, are you at the café yet? I'm outside.
Yep, I'm sitting at the back, by the window. Come on in.
Oh, I see you now! Coming over.
My nose is blocked again this morning. I just want to stay home.
Okay, get some rest. We can just meet tomorrow if you're feeling better.
